integrity: The exact polynomial recurrence is checked against independently labeled-state exact enumeration; the fluid invariant and variance integral are verified algebraically; finite Monte Carlo is corroborative, not proof. The infinite probabilistic limits are supported by the written martingale argument.
scientific_limitations: Equal-rate irreversible edge dimer adsorption on complete split graphs with fixed positive limiting clique and independent-set proportions. No claim for unequal rates, sublinear population ratios, or finite-time kinetics. Published historical priority remains subject to unindexed sources and incomplete access to two foundational articles.
title: Exponential vacancy law and Gaussian fluctuations for dimer jamming on complete split graphs
